description: 80-dps Borel–Padé resummation of the divergent 4_1 Ohtsuki kappa-tower to the exact smooth Im V, cross-checked against Andersen & Mistegard [andersen-mistegard2020] (arXiv:1811.05376v4, Theorems 2 & 3; bean qou-r0fd). (1) Large-order kappa ratio and real Borel–Padé[3/3] pole match the 4_1 complex Chern–Simons saddle gap A = Vol(4_1)/pi = 0.64613184... (arg 0, strictly off the imaginary substrate ray arg pi/2 => single-valued Borel sum Im V_b = 0.0554524..., zero Stokes ambiguity). (2) On Sigma(2,3,5) (P=30), Borel–Padé[5/5] of Theorem 2 eq. (4) recovers the leading complex-CS pole zeta_1 = i*pi/60 (theta_1 = -1/120) to < 1e-10 and Theorem 3's Borel–Laplace contour integral reproduces GPPV Z_hat_0(q=e^{-pi/2}) to < 1e-70 at 80 dps. Scope-(a); C14; zero float64; zero fit; no c_k wired.
